summary.intent: Use the GSD manager dashboard to drive milestone v2.0 (Metadata and Sharing Refactor) forward — resolve a stalled Phase 69, then dispatch planning/discussion for the newly-unblocked phases 70 and 71.
summary.outcome: Diagnosed that Phase 69 (FUSE/WinFsp) was actually already merged (PR #594), verified (5/5 local success criteria passed), and green on CI, but showed as 'partial' in GSD only due to a miscount; ran `gsd-tools phase complete 69` to fix state (milestone now 11/15). Dispatched Phase 70 planning in the background and started Phase 71 discussion inline, which is mid-flight tracing root-ownership flows per user request.

repo: gsd-tools' init.manager derives phase status from disk by globbing `*PLAN*.md` filenames; a research file named `69-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md` matched the glob (due to 'PLANE') and was miscounted as a 26th plan, making a fully-complete 25/25 phase look 'partial'.
`gsd-tools verify phase-completeness {N}` is the authoritative/strict completeness check (correctly reported 25/25 for phase 69) — trust it over init.manager's disk-based status when they disagree.

`gsd-tools phase complete {N}` updates ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, and requirements, but does NOT fix init.manager's stale 'partial' rendering — that's a separate (buggy) code path reading raw directory contents.

A plan can be marked `autonomous:false` (e.g. 69-14, the WinFsp platform layer) meaning it's verified in CI rather than locally — this can prevent the phase-complete marker from auto-setting even when the phase is fully done and merged.
On Claude Code runtime specifically, gsd-manager runs plan/execute inline rather than backgrounding them — only Codex runtime backgrounds those steps (per manager.md runtime resolution logic).

code.finding: Filename contains the substring 'PLANE' which false-matches a `*PLAN*.md` glob used by init.manager's plan-counting logic, causing an off-by-one miscount (26 plans vs 25 summaries) that renders a complete phase as 'partial'.

workflow: Before re-running execution on a phase that shows 'partial'/stalled, check for prior completion signals first (merge status via PR, VERIFICATION.md verdict, CI gate status on the merge commit) rather than assuming unfinished work and re-churning shipped code.

For gsd-discuss-phase, dispatching a scout/Explore-style agent to read the phase's source todos and current code up front lets the assistant filter out mechanical todos and present only genuine gray-area decisions to the user, rather than asking about already-obvious items.

friction: After running `phase complete 69`, the manager dashboard still showed completed_count=10 and Phase 70 with unmet deps, requiring additional digging (inspecting fresh per-phase state, ROADMAP checkbox, and the plan-file glob) to confirm the update actually succeeded and identify the real (cosmetic) cause.
The `*PLAN*.md` glob bug in init.manager's disk-status derivation causes false 'partial' readings whenever a non-plan file's name happens to contain 'PLAN' as a substring.
open_items: The init.manager glob miscount bug (matching 'PLANE' as 'PLAN') is unfixed — diagnosed as cosmetic and out of scope for this session; the research file was intentionally not renamed to dodge it.

Phase 71 discuss session is mid-flight: root-ownership flows are being traced in code before the user decides between options; CID-equivocation Hard-guard-vs-reject decision is still provisional/unlocked; TEE re-sign contract and re-claim merge-vs-reject semantics questions were deferred by the user in favor of root-ownership first.
Phase 70 background planning agent was dispatched but its result had not yet returned by end of transcript.
